sentences.text:
For the Petitioner : Mr. R.S. Mazumdar, Sr. Adv.
 Ms. J. Mazumdar, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Manoj Kr. Mishra ,Addl. PP 02 / 19.09.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Govindpur P.S. Case No.65 of 2023 registered under sections 323/324/506/420/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner cheated the complainant by selling the land belonging to him over which, he had no possession and though there was a settlement in the Govindpur police station in which, the petitioner agreed to return Rs. 14,00,000/- but he is not returning the same.

It is then submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and admittedly, the petitioner has executed the registered sale deed in respect of the said land and mutation has been done in the name of the informant and there is no allegation against the petitioner of having any intention to deceive the informant before the entrustment of money for execution of the sale deed.

It is next submitted that the petitioner is ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case and the dispute between the parties is at best a civil dispute hence, the petitioner be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
The learned Addl. PP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing Manik Ruj @ Manik Chandra Ruj vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
